To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a multifunction aperture can be realized with multiple feeds around a spherical lens and that the radiation patterns of the feeds can be controlled by the spherical lens.
we have designed and fabricated a multifunction aperture that provides multiple beams with different radiation patterns for 24 GHz and for 77 GHz radar.
the multifunctional lens aperture has been demonstrated to be an effective approach to integrating 24 GHz and long range 77 GHz radar into the same aperture.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: 1) The design of the spherical lens and the feed network for the lens, 2) The fabrication of a 24 GHz and a 77 GHz multifunction aperture, and 3) The experimental characterization of the aperture.
the development of new antenna concepts for vehicular radar systems and the design, fabrication and testing of prototype antennas.
the development of new multifunction antenna technology that is suitable for automotive radar systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the design and fabrication of a spherical lens with 24 GHz and a 77 GHz feed was successful.
the proposed multifunction aperture is an attractive solution to the need for both long and short range radar on the same vehicle.
the proposed multifunctional aperture is a promising solution to integrate 24 GHz and/or 77 GHz radars into a vehicle front.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the measured results are very close to the simulated ones, which is a very good indicator of the accuracy of the simulation models used for this design.
the measured radiation patterns and beam widths are in close agreement with the simulated results.
the multifunction aperture can meet the performance requirements for 24 GHz and long range 77 GHz radar applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the lens aperture can be designed to provide the desired radiation patterns for both radar systems with a simple feed design.
this multifunction aperture can be used for short and long range radar integration in a vehicle.
a single aperture can be designed to support multiple radar applications.
